name: Employee
description: Central data model containing employee demographics, contact information, employment details, and onboarding status tracking

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the employee

fields.name: fullName
fields.description: Employee's full legal name

fields.name: email
fields.description: Employee's work email address

fields.name: department
fields.description: Department to which the employee is assigned

fields.name: startDate
fields.description: Employee's first day of employment

fields.name: onboardingStatus
fields.description: Current status in the onboarding process (e.g., pending, in-progress, completed)

fields.name: onboardingCompletionPercentage
fields.description: Percentage of onboarding tasks completed (0-100)

name: DocumentType
description: Reference data model defining required document categories for employee onboarding compliance with validation rules and department-specific requirements

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the document type

fields.name: name
fields.description: Name of the document type (e.g., 'Tax Form W-4', 'Government ID', 'Employment Contract')

fields.name: category
fields.description: Document category (e.g., 'TAX_FORM', 'IDENTIFICATION', 'CONTRACT', 'COMPLIANCE', 'CERTIFICATION')

fields.name: isRequired
fields.description: Indicates whether this document is mandatory for onboarding completion

fields.name: department
fields.description: Specific department requirement (null if applicable to all departments)

fields.name: validationRules
fields.description: JSON string containing validation rules (file format, size limits, expiration requirements)

fields.name: isActive
fields.description: Indicates if this document type is currently active and should be requested

name: ITEquipment
description: Tracks IT equipment inventory including laptops, monitors, phones, and software licenses with assignment status and availability

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the equipment item

fields.name: equipmentType
fields.description: Type of equipment (laptop, monitor, phone, accessory, software_license)

fields.name: serialNumber
fields.description: Manufacturer serial number or license key for unique identification

fields.name: specifications
fields.description: Equipment specifications (brand, model, specs, etc.)

fields.name: status
fields.description: Current status (available, assigned, in_repair, retired)

fields.name: assignedToEmployeeId
fields.description: ID of employee currently assigned to this equipment

fields.name: assignedDate
fields.description: Date when equipment was assigned to current employee

fields.name: purchaseDate
fields.description: Date when equipment was purchased

name: User
description: Store user accounts with role-based access control information for authentication and authorization

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the user account

fields.name: username
fields.description: Unique username for login authentication

fields.name: passwordHash
fields.description: Hashed password for secure authentication

fields.name: roles
fields.description: Assigned roles (HR Admin, IT Department, Manager, New Employee) supporting multi-role assignments

fields.name: departmentId
fields.description: Department affiliation for the user

fields.name: employeeId
fields.description: Reference to associated employee record if applicable

fields.name: isActive
fields.description: Indicates if the user account is active and can access the system

fields.name: lastLoginAt
fields.description: Timestamp of the user's last successful login

relationships.description: Links user account to employee record

constraints.uniqueUsername: Username must be unique across all users
constraints.validRoles: Roles must be one of: HR Admin, IT Department, Manager, New Employee

name: Document
description: Manages employee documents with versioning and audit trail capabilities for onboarding process

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the document

fields.name: employeeId
fields.description: Reference to the employee who owns this document

fields.name: documentTypeId
fields.description: Reference to the type of document (e.g., ID, contract, certificate)

fields.name: fileUrl
fields.description: Storage location or URL of the uploaded document file

fields.name: versionNumber
fields.description: Version number for document re-submissions (starts at 1)

fields.name: verificationStatus
fields.description: Current verification status (pending, approved, rejected)

fields.name: approvedBy
fields.description: Reference to the User who approved or rejected the document

fields.name: uploadedAt
fields.description: Timestamp when the document was uploaded

relationships.description: Each document belongs to one employee
Each document has one document type
Each document may be approved by one user

indexes.description: Ensures unique version numbers per document type per employee
Optimizes queries filtering by verification status
Supports chronological queries and audit trail

versionNumber.description: Version number must be at least 1

name: TrainingPlan
description: Structured training programs for new employees with curriculum, objectives, and completion criteria

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the training plan

fields.name: name
fields.description: Name of the training plan

fields.name: roleType
fields.description: Target role or department for this training plan

fields.name: durationDays
fields.description: Expected duration to complete training in days

fields.name: learningObjectives
fields.description: Detailed learning objectives and curriculum content

fields.name: requiredResources
fields.description: List of required resources, materials, and tools

fields.name: completionCriteria
fields.description: Criteria and requirements for successful completion

fields.name: isActive
fields.description: Whether this training plan is currently active and available

name: TrainingMilestone
description: Track individual training tasks and completion progress with assessment results and sign-off records

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the training milestone

fields.name: trainingPlanId
fields.description: Reference to the parent training plan

fields.name: title
fields.description: Name of the training milestone or task

fields.name: description
fields.description: Detailed description of the training activity

fields.name: dueDate
fields.description: Target completion date for this milestone

fields.name: completionStatus
fields.description: Current status: pending, in_progress, completed, failed

fields.name: completedDate
fields.description: Actual date when milestone was completed

fields.name: assessmentScore
fields.description: Numerical score or percentage from assessment (0-100)

relationships.description: Each milestone belongs to one training plan
User who approved/signed off the milestone completion

name: ApprovalRecord
description: Maintains comprehensive audit trail of all approval decisions across onboarding workflows with approver details and decision history

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the approval record

fields.name: approverId
fields.description: Reference to User who made the approval decision

fields.name: entityType
fields.description: Type of entity being approved (Document, TrainingPlan, ITEquipment, Employee)

fields.name: entityId
fields.description: Reference ID of the entity being approved

fields.name: decision
fields.description: Approval decision status (approved, rejected, returned, pending)

fields.name: comments
fields.description: Approver comments or notes explaining the decision

fields.name: approvalStage
fields.description: Sequential stage number in multi-stage approval chain

fields.name: timestamp
fields.description: Date and time when the approval decision was made

relationships.description: Links to the User who performed the approval

indexes.description: Optimize queries for approval history by entity
Optimize queries for approver activity history
Optimize queries for filtering by decision status

entityType.description: Valid entity types that can be approved

name: OnboardingWorkflow
description: Master workflow state tracker monitoring current stage, completion percentage, pending tasks, blocked items, and milestone achievements for employee onboarding

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the onboarding workflow instance

fields.name: employeeId
fields.description: Reference to the employee being onboarded

fields.name: currentStage
fields.description: Current stage of onboarding (e.g., PRE_BOARDING, DAY_ONE, WEEK_ONE, MONTH_ONE, COMPLETED)

fields.name: completionPercentage
fields.description: Overall completion percentage of the onboarding workflow (0-100)

fields.name: status
fields.description: Workflow status (ACTIVE, BLOCKED, COMPLETED, CANCELLED)

fields.name: startDate
fields.description: Date when the onboarding workflow started

fields.name: targetCompletionDate
fields.description: Expected completion date (typically 30 days from start)

fields.name: blockedReason
fields.description: Reason for workflow blockage if status is BLOCKED

relationships.description: Links workflow to the employee being onboarded
Training plans associated with this onboarding workflow
Documents required and submitted during onboarding
Approval records for various onboarding milestones

indexes.description: Ensure one active workflow per employee
Optimize queries for workflow monitoring and reporting
Support escalation trigger queries for overdue workflows

constraints.status: Must be one of: ACTIVE, BLOCKED, COMPLETED, CANCELLED
constraints.currentStage: Must be one of: PRE_BOARDING, DAY_ONE, WEEK_ONE, WEEK_TWO, MONTH_ONE, COMPLETED

name: Notification
description: Queue and track system notifications and reminders for employee onboarding

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the notification

fields.name: recipientId
fields.description: Reference to the recipient (Employee or User ID)

fields.name: channel
fields.description: Delivery channel: email, in-app, or sms

fields.name: priority
fields.description: Priority level: low, medium, high, or urgent

fields.name: status
fields.description: Delivery status: pending, sent, delivered, failed, or cancelled

fields.name: message
fields.description: Notification message content or template reference

fields.name: scheduledAt
fields.description: Scheduled delivery timestamp

fields.name: retryCount
fields.description: Number of delivery retry attempts

relationships.description: Notification belongs to an employee recipient

name: ReviewSchedule
description: Manages scheduled review meetings and check-ins during employee onboarding process

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the review schedule

fields.name: employeeId
fields.description: Reference to the employee being onboarded

fields.name: reviewType
fields.description: Type of review (1-week, 2-week, 30-day, custom)

fields.name: scheduledDate
fields.description: Date and time when the review meeting is scheduled

fields.name: participants
fields.description: List of user IDs participating in the review meeting

fields.name: meetingLink
fields.description: Virtual meeting URL or location details

fields.name: status
fields.description: Current status (scheduled, completed, cancelled, rescheduled)

fields.name: completionNotes
fields.description: Notes and outcomes recorded after the review is completed

relationships.description: Links review schedule to the employee being onboarded
Users participating in the review meeting

name: AuditLog
description: Immutable log of all system actions for compliance, security monitoring, and forensic analysis

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the audit log entry

fields.name: userId
fields.description: ID of the user who performed the action

fields.name: timestamp
fields.description: Date and time when the action occurred

fields.name: actionType
fields.description: Type of action performed (CREATE, UPDATE, DELETE, VIEW, APPROVE, etc.)

fields.name: entityType
fields.description: Type of entity affected (Employee, Document, ITEquipment, etc.)

fields.name: entityId
fields.description: ID of the affected entity

fields.name: changes
fields.description: JSON object containing before and after values of modified fields

fields.name: ipAddress
fields.description: IP address from which the action was performed

relationships.description: Links to the user who performed the action

constraints.retentionPolicy: Retain for minimum 7 years for compliance requirements

name: EquipmentAssignment
description: Records equipment assignments to employees with tracking and acknowledgment details throughout the employee lifecycle

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the equipment assignment

fields.name: employeeId
fields.description: Reference to the employee receiving the equipment

fields.name: equipmentId
fields.description: Reference to the IT equipment being assigned

fields.name: assignmentDate
fields.description: Date when equipment was assigned to employee

fields.name: expectedReturnDate
fields.description: Expected date for equipment return (e.g., end of employment)

fields.name: conditionNotes
fields.description: Notes about equipment condition at time of assignment

fields.name: acknowledgmentStatus
fields.description: Status of employee acknowledgment (pending, acknowledged, declined)

fields.name: returnedDate
fields.description: Actual date when equipment was returned by employee

relationships.description: Each assignment belongs to one employee
Each assignment is for one piece of equipment

unique.description: Prevents duplicate assignments of same equipment on same date

check.description: Acknowledgment status must be one of the allowed values
